name: OSPYR·4 CREATIVE PRODUCTION BRAIN — 28 sub-automations: multi-client studio (image · video · voice · copy)

parameters.content:
# 🎨 O4 · CREATIVE PRODUCTION BRAIN (28 sub-automations)
Agency-grade, MULTI-CLIENT: every command starts with the client key, e.g. `#studio psg …` — the Brands tab supplies that client's colours/tone/watermark so output is on-brand automatically.

**IMAGE (7):** ① `#studio <client>` photo → Gemini studio re-shoot ② brand-aware prompt from Brands tab ③ watermark note ④ batch mode (send album) ⑤ ad-variant prompt (`#adshot`) ⑥ background swap (`#bg <scene>`) ⑦ product-card copy block.
**VIDEO (6):** ⑧ `#video <client> idea` → Cloudinary → Higgsfield image→video ⑨ UGC-style prompt preset ⑩ cinematic preset (`#film`) ⑪ poll+deliver link ⑫ reel-caption auto-drafted ⑬ saved to ClientAssets tab.
**VOICE (4):** ⑭ `#voice <client> script` → ElevenLabs (per-client voice ID from Brands tab) ⑮ multilingual ⑯ ad-read preset ⑰ IVR/greeting preset.
**COPY (6):** ⑱ `#captions <client> product` week of captions ⑲ `#ads <client>` 5 ad-copy variants ⑳ `#hooks` 10 reel hooks ㉑ `#seo` meta title/desc ㉒ `#email` campaign draft ㉓ tone locked to client brand voice.
**OPS (5):** ㉔ every output logged to ClientAssets ㉕ daily 18:00 production recap ㉖ asset-request detection ㉗ client-approval forward note ㉘ usage counter per client (billing evidence).

**KEYS:** GEMINI_API_KEY · HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY · ELEVENLABS_API_KEY · CLOUDINARY_CLOUD/PRESET · TG_OSPYR_CHAT · OSPYR_SHEET_ID (tabs: Brands[Client,Colors,Tone,VoiceID,Watermark], ClientAssets).
**FIX:** wrong brand style → fill Brands row for that client key; Higgsfield path differs per account → fix in the 2 Higgsfield nodes only.
